description: drowzeys' hybrid quant of deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash: routed tail experts in EXL3-TR3 K=3 (mcg codebook, ~3.0 bpw), the 64 highest round-trip-error experts per layer kept native MXFP4, everything else (attention, indexer, Engram tables, hyper-connections) in the release's own format; about 3.22 bpw MoE mix, 410 GB in 48 shards (release: 476 GB). Includes vision. MIT.
